Term.description: One value (or reason) of a vocabulary: what it is, what counts as it and what does not.

definition.description: what the value means, as one or two sentences that stand on their own
definition.title: Definition

counts.description: cases that are this value, each a short phrase
counts.title: Counts

does_not_count.description: cases that are not, though they may look like it, each a short phrase that names what they are instead where it can
does_not_count.title: Does Not Count

Term.title: Term

description:
A classification scheme's vocabulary. Its functional content (hashed in ``catalog.index``) is everything but
``description`` and ``provenance``: a definition is what a model tagger is shown, so a changed definition changes
what it answers.

scheme.description: the classification scheme it defines (linecaster.data.SCHEMES), also its id
scheme.title: Scheme

description.description: what the scheme classifies, in a sentence (not functional)
description.title: Description

targets.description: what the scheme classifies, narrowest first: span, word, line, region, page
targets.title: Targets

values.description: the closed list of values, by value
values.title: Values

open.description: the values are not listed: each matches pattern (language, script)
open.title: Open

pattern.description: an open scheme's values, as a regular expression
pattern.title: Pattern

answers.description: a property scheme (values yes and no): the answer that means each value, named after the property (yes: degraded, no: not_degraded)
answers.title: Answers

reasons.description: status only: the values of a classification's reason, why something present in a source is no text of the page
reasons.title: Reasons

provenance.description: where the definitions come from or what they are adapted from (not functional)
provenance.title: Provenance

title: VocabularyDoc
